title: NEW PROJECT! CUSTOM EXHAUST FOR +500HP SUPERCHARGED MERCEDES
description:
Get entered to win the RX-8: http://www.throtl.com/get_vip

In this video, we kick off a project we've been looking forward to a LONG time...a 2006 Mercedes CLS55 AMG. This rare (1 year only) beast has a Supercharged 5.4 liter V8 that makes some serious power and torque. We are going to make it look the part, and unleash about 100WHP more putting the power over 550HP! The exhaust was just step 1. Stay tuned for more!

Huge shout out to Jesse's Mufflers for the custom exhaust work. He can make custom exhausts for anything. Hit him up and get your car in there! http://www.jessesmufflersandbrakes.com/

Thank you, Adam @socaltires, for encouraging this project and all your help along the way! Go follow him! https://www.instagram.com/socaltires/
